How do you cancel Chillio and get a refund?

It depends on where you paid. Check your App Store or Google Play subscriptions first, then your email for a receipt from Chillio's website.

  • Paid in the App Store: cancel in Settings, then your name, then Subscriptions, as described in Apple's cancellation guide. Refunds go through Apple's refund request page, not Chillio.
  • Paid on Google Play: cancel under Payments and subscriptions in the Play Store, per Google's help page.
  • Paid on get-chillio.app: deleting the app does not cancel it. Cancel in the account settings or email support@get-chillio.app from the address you paid with, at least 24 hours before the period ends, per Chillio's web subscription terms.

The same terms say the guarantee does not cover "I didn't like it" or "I didn't expect to be charged." Several App Store reviewers say they were offered a 30% or 50% partial refund instead.
new:
How do you cancel Chillio and get a refund?

Cancel where you paid, at least 24 hours before renewal. Deleting the app cancels nothing, and Chillio's own terms say so.

Where did you pay?

Check your email first. A "receipt from Apple" means the App Store, a Google Play order email means Google, and a payment email after a quiz on get-chillio.app means you paid Chillio directly through its website.

A website subscription never shows up in your iPhone's subscription list. Apple says that if you can't find one there, "you might've bought the subscription from another company," and you need to cancel with that company (Apple Support).

Paid in the App Store or on Google Play

  • iPhone: open Settings, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, tap Chillio, then tap Cancel Subscription. To ask for money back, use Apple's refund request page, since Apple, not Chillio, handles App Store refunds.
  • Android: open Subscriptions in Google Play, select Chillio, tap Cancel subscription and follow the instructions. Google says "when you uninstall the app, your subscription won't cancel," and that you keep access for the time you've already paid (Google Play Help).

Paid on Chillio's website

Log in at get-chillio.app with the same email and password you used when you signed up, then cancel from your account. That is what Chillio's own "Manage your subscription" page tells users to do.

You can also email support@get-chillio.app at least 24 hours before the trial or billing period ends. Chillio's Terms of Use say subscription requests must come from the email you use to log in, so send it from that inbox and ask for written confirmation.

The flow asks you to stay twice before it cancels. Tap "Continue to cancel," not "Keep my plan," and skip "Claim free month": claiming it keeps your full access active, so you stay subscribed.

At the end, your account should show "Your subscription is cancelled." Take a screenshot of it and of the "Active until" date.

We built these steps from the text on Chillio's site rather than clicking through ourselves, so your screens may look a little different.

Can you get a refund?

Web payments are "non-refundable" except under a money-back guarantee for people who did not get "recognizable changes/results." You must ask within 30 days of your first purchase, have followed the program for 6 days in a row (4 for weekly plans), and send screenshots of completed lessons.

The guarantee doesn't cover simply not liking the product, or not realizing the trial would turn into a paid plan. Add-ons are generally final.

Several App Store reviewers say they were offered a 30% or 50% partial refund instead.

If a website charge goes through after you cancel, email support with your screenshot, then call your card company. For credit cards, the FTC says your written dispute should reach the issuer within 60 days after the first bill with the error was sent to you (FTC).
